sentences.text:
Shaik Imran Pasha vs The State Of Telangana on 10 January,
2025
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi

entities.text: Shaik Imran Pasha vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.15766 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS by the petitioner/accused to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.123 of 2024 of Kalapattar Police Station, Hyderabad,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2), 417 and 420 of IPC.
2.

It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2024 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 02.01.2025, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 07.01.2025 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2024 are allowed.
Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in Crime No.123 of 2024 of Kalapattar Police Station, Hyderabad, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
JUVVADI SRIDEVI, J Date: 10.01.2025 Ksk Shaik Imran Pasha vs The State Of Telangana
